title: Review rating
description: Rate a review from 1 to 5 stars and check what it mentions: an ordered score and two yes/no questions.

stars.instructions: How many stars does the review's text imply?
criteria: 2 stars: poor, more bad than good

mentions_price.instructions: The review comments on the price or on value for money.

mentions_service.instructions: The review comments on staff, delivery or customer service.

examples.name: Glowing
examples.state: Best ramen in the neighbourhood. The broth is rich, the portions are generous and the staff remembered us from last time. A bit pricey, but worth every cent.

examples.name: Mixed
examples.state: The headphones sound great and the battery lasts all week, but the ear cushions started peeling after two months. Okay for the price.

examples.name: Bad
examples.state: Arrived three days late with the box crushed and one chair leg missing. Support took a week to reply and then asked me for photos twice. Never again.
